import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    r,K0,K1,w,A,h = params[0],params[1],params[2],params[3],params[4],params[5]
    K = K0 + K1*np.sin(w*t)
    return r*P*(1-P/K)*(P/A-1) - h*P

import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
